title: backlog.json defaults lane_module to kblane and land_push to the kb's kbgit.py sync, so a host project must override both (second-project run)
goal: A project with no backlog.json, or one naming neither key, gets an empty lane_module (no code lane) and an empty land_push, so land stops at the push step naming the land_push key the project must set; a land_push the project names runs as before; the kb's backlog.json names its own lane_module and land_push

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w').write('{}'); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'config'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; bad=[l for l in o.splitlines() if l.startswith(('lane_module = ','land_push = ')) and ('kblane' in l or 'kbgit' in l)]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_base,bl_land,bl_close; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w').write('{}'); bl_base.load_settings(d); ok=[]; exec('try:'+chr(10)+' bl_land.land_push()'+chr(10)+'except bl_close.Refused as e:'+chr(10)+' ok.append("land_push" in str(e) and "land stopped at step" in str(e))'); print(ok); sys.exit(0 if ok==[True] else 1)

import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_base,bl_land; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); open(os.path.join(d,'backlog.json'),'w').write('{"land_push": ["git", "push", "origin", "HEAD:main"]}'); bl_base.load_settings(d); sys.exit(0 if bl_land.land_push()[0]=='git push origin HEAD:main' else 1)

import subprocess,sys; o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','config'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; ls=[l for l in o.splitlines() if l.startswith(('lane_module = ','land_push = '))]; sys.exit(0 if len(ls)==2 and all('(file)' in l for l in ls) else 1)

gates.question: What do lane_module and land_push default to in a project whose backlog.json names neither?
options: lane_module empty (no code lane); land_push empty, so land stops before the push and names the key the project must set
lane_module empty; land_push defaults to git push of HEAD to the main branch
gates.recommendation: lane_module empty (no code lane); land_push empty, so land stops before the push and names the key the project must set

gates.question: How does an empty land_push reach the push step's refusal?
options: land_push takes the argv type (an empty list allowed) and bl_land.land_push raises the push-step stop when it is empty
keep the command type and add an empty case to it

notes: Found while fixing BG-cmvwrpbr (seven other keys). Planned to the operator's answer: lane_module and land_push both empty by default, land stops at the push step naming land_push, the kb's backlog.json names both. Ran the filed repro: it fails, printing lane_module = kblane (default) and land_push = the kb gate script argv (default); its bad-line filter mixed and/or and it read a project with no file, so it is rewritten to plant backlog.json {} and filter each line. Ran each added check now: the land-stop check fails (bl_land.land_push() under planted {} settings returns the kb argv and raises no bl_close.Refused naming land_push), the named-command check passes, the kb-file check fails (land_push is default in config). Fix: bl_base.py SETTINGS defaults for lane_module and land_push, and the command kind, which refuses an empty list; bl_land.land_push (bl_land.py:670, one call at :1928) raises land_stop for the push step. Referrers read: bl_land.py:106,109 and bl_precheck.py:312 already treat an empty lane_module as no lane; skills/sprint/SKILL.md:17, kb/_self/backlog.md:300,310,421 and plugin.md:24 document the old defaults; .claude/skills/kb-sprint links to skills/sprint. bench_multi.py sets lane_module in the file, unaffected. Shares backlog.md and tools.md with BG-urlbsgsr.
